method: TTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025. Owner cash is normalized to retain SBC as an economic compensation cost and to adjust for the FY2025 deferred-tax valuation allowance release.
normalization_notes: FY2025 GAAP net income included a $22.845M deferred tax asset benefit/release; this is not treated as recurring owner earnings.
SBC is not separately added back to owner cash. Mechanical OCF-capex is a diagnostic only.
Interest income on the large cash portfolio is part of current reported economics but could change as cash is deployed into pipeline/commercial expansion.

share_quality.comment: Dilution is meaningful but not currently veto-level; monitor option/RSU issuance and owner-cash/share.
